question: Should ClickClack adopt author-visible editing of already-sent channel and thread messages as a permanent core interaction?
rationale: The patch is a new user-facing capability rather than repair of an established UI contract, and no supplied maintainer discussion confirms the desired long-term message-history policy.

options.title: Adopt bounded message editing
options.body: Accept author-only inline editing for persisted channel and thread messages and review this implementation on its normal merge merits.

options.title: Defer the interaction
options.body: Keep the existing immutable-message UI and close or pause this proposal until a broader message-history policy is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Adopt bounded message editing
recommendation.body: Accept author-only inline editing for persisted channel and thread messages and review this implementation on its normal merge merits.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main ownership could not be established from the supplied context, so a product owner familiar with ClickClack message semantics should decide.
